housing_building_stock_character: Mixed residential and industrial suburb; grew around the 1889 railway station with post-war settlement (incl. German Templer community). Explicitly described as both residential and industrial; no detailed dwelling-type breakdown stated in source.
source_quotes: Bayswater is a residential and industrial suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 28 km (17 mi) east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the City of Knox local government area.
Bayswater recorded a population of 12,262 at the 2021 census.
When the railway arrived in 1889, a Bayswater office near the station replaced Macauley.
In the late 1940s, a number of German Templers ... settled in Bayswater and Boronia.
